# Nell Harcourt & Uncle Saul

- [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) — Friend of — [Uncle Saul](../character/uncle-saul.md) — mutual goodwill upon meeting · since v4  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 6 CAPTAIN SAUL P9](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0009), [v4 CHAPTER 13 A GHOSTLY EVENING P16](../source/v04-c13.md#nw-v04-c13-p0016), [v4 CHAPTER 17 A SEVEN GULLS WINTER P16](../source/v04-c17.md#nw-v04-c17-p0016), +3 more</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Hugh settle into their new dwelling where [Doctor Dave](../character/doctor-dave.md), Mrs. Doctor Dave, and Captain Saul welcome them over a evening supper. During the meal, Captain Saul shares stories about his kindness to a stray dog and provides details about their nearby neighbors.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 6 CAPTAIN SAUL

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 6 CAPTAIN SAUL P0](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0000), [v4 CHAPTER 6 CAPTAIN SAUL P8](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0008), [v4 CHAPTER 6 CAPTAIN SAUL P16](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0016), [v4 CHAPTER 6 CAPTAIN SAUL P28](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0028)_

> Gathered by the hearth, Captain Saul recounts the history of the house and its original owners, the schoolmaster [John Tremayne](../character/john-tremayne.md) and his bride [Damaris Leigh](../character/damaris-leigh.md). He tells how [Tremayne](../character/john-tremayne.md) foresaw her safe arrival aboard the [Royal William](../codex/tech.md#royal-william) after a long delay, after which the town welcomed her and celebrated their wedding.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P0](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0000), [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P5](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0005), [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P34](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0034), [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P45](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0045)_

> Captain Saul shares memories of the house's past inhabitants and chats with [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) about the moon and kindred spirits. The guests take their leave, leaving [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Hugh to walk through their moonlit garden together in happiness.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P48](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0048), [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P54](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0054), [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P60](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0060), [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P64](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0064)_

> Miss Winifred [Tolley](../character/winifred-tolley.md) converses with [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), sharing her frank and sharp opinions on men, local ministers, and village acquaintances like Captain Saul and [Elizabeth Russell](../character/elizabeth-russell.md). After [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) asks her to stay for tea, Miss Winifred reveals she knew Hugh was secretly listening to her comments from the adjoining room.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 8 MISS WINIFRED TOLLEY COMES TO CALL

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS WINIFRED TOLLEY COMES TO CALL P39](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0039), [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS WINIFRED TOLLEY COMES TO CALL P57](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0057), [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS WINIFRED TOLLEY COMES TO CALL P71](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0071), [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS WINIFRED TOLLEY COMES TO CALL P79](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0079)_

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Hugh walk down to [Seven Gulls](../codex/places.md#seven-gulls) light, passing a strange bearded man on the way. They visit Captain Saul at the lighthouse, where he shows them the lights and machinery and serves them tea. Over tea, Captain Saul explains that the man they saw was [Ambrose Kerr](../character/ambrose.md), who vowed not to cut his hair or beard until the [Liberal](../codex/factions.md#liberal) party won an election.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT SEVEN GULLS POINT

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT SEVEN GULLS POINT P13](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0013), [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT SEVEN GULLS POINT P19](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0019), [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT SEVEN GULLS POINT P23](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0023), [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT SEVEN GULLS POINT P34](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0034)_

> Captain Saul shares stories about how he rescued his cat, [First Mate](../character/first-mate.md), and confronted the owner who abandoned it. He then shows [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Hugh his collection of curiosities and captivating tales from his life at sea. As they prepare to leave, [Saul](../character/uncle-saul.md) reflects on his yearning for adventure and his past companions before [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Hugh walk home discussing him.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT SEVEN GULLS POINT

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT SEVEN GULLS POINT P38](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0038), [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT SEVEN GULLS POINT P46](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0046), [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT SEVEN GULLS POINT P49](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0049), [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT SEVEN GULLS POINT P57](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0057)_

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) walks through a foggy night to visit [Lorna Vane](../character/lorna-vane.md), but retreats upon seeing [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) weeping bitterly inside her home. Outside, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) encounters Captain Saul [Garrick](../character/uncle-saul.md) and [Rufus Vane](../character/rufus-vane.md), and Captain Saul walks her back home while discussing [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) and the nature of the foggy darkness.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 13 A GHOSTLY EVENING

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 13 A GHOSTLY EVENING P0](../source/v04-c13.md#nw-v04-c13-p0000), [v4 CHAPTER 13 A GHOSTLY EVENING P5](../source/v04-c13.md#nw-v04-c13-p0005), [v4 CHAPTER 13 A GHOSTLY EVENING P6](../source/v04-c13.md#nw-v04-c13-p0006), [v4 CHAPTER 13 A GHOSTLY EVENING P19](../source/v04-c13.md#nw-v04-c13-p0019)_

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Hugh spend autumn evenings at the lighthouse with Captain Saul and [Lorna Vane](../character/lorna-vane.md), engaging in conversations and listening to stories. Walking home together afterward, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Hugh affectionately discuss Lorna's potential, their own happiness, and their shared home as they look forward to spring.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 14 NOVEMBER DAYS

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 14 NOVEMBER DAYS P2](../source/v04-c14.md#nw-v04-c14-p0002), [v4 CHAPTER 14 NOVEMBER DAYS P6](../source/v04-c14.md#nw-v04-c14-p0006), [v4 CHAPTER 14 NOVEMBER DAYS P7](../source/v04-c14.md#nw-v04-c14-p0007), [v4 CHAPTER 14 NOVEMBER DAYS P16](../source/v04-c14.md#nw-v04-c14-p0016)_

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Hugh host their first [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) dinner at their home in [Seven Gulls](../codex/places.md#seven-gulls) with [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md), [Agatha Sowerby](../character/agatha-sowerby.md), Captain Saul, and [Winifred Tolley](../character/winifred-tolley.md) in attendance. During the visit, Miss Winifred and Captain Saul exchange lively, opinionated stories and debates about local gossip, church politics, and historical feuds while Hugh entertains them. After Hugh carefully carves the geese under Nell's instructions, the group enjoys a successful feast and listens to Captain Saul's tales by the fire.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 15 CHRISTMAS AT SEVEN GULLS

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 15 CHRISTMAS AT SEVEN GULLS P1](../source/v04-c15.md#nw-v04-c15-p0001), [v4 CHAPTER 15 CHRISTMAS AT SEVEN GULLS P5](../source/v04-c15.md#nw-v04-c15-p0005), [v4 CHAPTER 15 CHRISTMAS AT SEVEN GULLS P7](../source/v04-c15.md#nw-v04-c15-p0007), [v4 CHAPTER 15 CHRISTMAS AT SEVEN GULLS P53](../source/v04-c15.md#nw-v04-c15-p0053)_

> In the kitchen, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) reprimands Hugh and Captain Saul for baiting [Winifred Tolley](../character/winifred-tolley.md) before instructing Hugh to carve the geese. Hugh carves the [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) meal successfully, and the group enjoys a festive dinner followed by storytelling by the hearth. Afterward, Captain Saul prepares to head back to the lighthouse and invites [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) to visit him.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 15 CHRISTMAS AT SEVEN GULLS

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 15 CHRISTMAS AT SEVEN GULLS P48](../source/v04-c15.md#nw-v04-c15-p0048), [v4 CHAPTER 15 CHRISTMAS AT SEVEN GULLS P49](../source/v04-c15.md#nw-v04-c15-p0049), [v4 CHAPTER 15 CHRISTMAS AT SEVEN GULLS P53](../source/v04-c15.md#nw-v04-c15-p0053), [v4 CHAPTER 15 CHRISTMAS AT SEVEN GULLS P54](../source/v04-c15.md#nw-v04-c15-p0054)_

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), Hugh, and [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) walk to [Seven Gulls Point](../codex/places.md#seven-gulls-point) lighthouse on New Year's Eve, catching a rare glimpse of Venus's shadow along the way. At the lighthouse, they gather with Captain Saul and [Ambrose Kerr](../character/ambrose.md), who entertains everyone with songs and dances a wild, exhilarating dance with [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md). As midnight strikes, Captain Saul opens the door to welcome the [New Year](../codex/places.md#new-year) and offers a hopeful toast to all present.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 16 NEW YEAR’S EVE AT THE LIGHT

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 16 NEW YEAR’S EVE AT THE LIGHT P3](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0003), [v4 CHAPTER 16 NEW YEAR’S EVE AT THE LIGHT P6](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0006), [v4 CHAPTER 16 NEW YEAR’S EVE AT THE LIGHT P11](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0011), [v4 CHAPTER 16 NEW YEAR’S EVE AT THE LIGHT P21](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0021)_

> During a cold winter at [Seven Gulls](../codex/places.md#seven-gulls), [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) spends time with [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) and Captain Saul, though she senses an underlying distance and resentment from [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) despite their friendship. After [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) reacts bitterly to news of Nell's upcoming child, she later gifts [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) a delicately handmade baby gown. Meanwhile, Captain Saul shares his written life log with [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), who wishes a talented writer like [Cedric](../character/cedric-stanhope.md) could turn his adventurous life into a book.
>

Captain Saul borders Nell's garden beds with shells, and the group engages in lively conversation and banter about theology, local gossip, and neighbors.
>

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 18 SPRING DAYS P6](../source/v04-c18.md#nw-v04-c18-p0006), [v4 CHAPTER 18 SPRING DAYS P10](../source/v04-c18.md#nw-v04-c18-p0010), [v4 CHAPTER 18 SPRING DAYS P15](../source/v04-c18.md#nw-v04-c18-p0015), [v4 CHAPTER 18 SPRING DAYS P17](../source/v04-c18.md#nw-v04-c18-p0017)_

> [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) comes to stay at the house to help [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) during her pregnancy and labor. [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) gives birth to a baby girl, whom she names [Joyce](../character/joyce.md), but the baby dies shortly after birth, leaving [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Hugh devastated. The community grieves with them as [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) slowly recovers while mourning her loss.
>

Captain Saul comforts [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) over her grief regarding [Joyce](../character/joyce.md) and tells her the story of his long-lost love, [Margaret](../character/margaret.md), asking [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) to remember her and pass on her story.
>

Later, Miss Winifred and Captain Saul visit, conversing about village locals and announcing that a young journalist named [Adrian Treleaven](../character/adrian-treleaven.md) will soon be staying with [Lorna Vane](../character/lorna-vane.md).
>

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) introduces [Adrian Treleaven](../character/adrian-treleaven.md) to Captain Saul at [Seven Gulls Point](../codex/places.md#seven-gulls-point), where [Saul](../character/uncle-saul.md) realizes Adrian is the grandson of Damaris [Tremayne](../character/john-tremayne.md). [Saul](../character/uncle-saul.md) shares colorful stories of his sea-faring past and lends Adrian his treasured life-book to read.
>

> [Adrian Treleaven](../character/adrian-treleaven.md) agrees to write Captain Saul's life story incorporating the tale of lost [Margaret](../character/margaret.md), and he spends a glorious summer working on the manuscript at the lighthouse. Along with [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), Hugh, [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md), and [Saul](../character/uncle-saul.md), Adrian enjoys coastal outings while finishing the novel, which he concludes by September.
>

> Miss Winifred and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) chat over the newspaper obituaries and past parish stories, including a story about an overzealous evangelist named [Fiske](../character/fiske.md). [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) mourns the death of her loyal old dog [Carlo](../character/carlo.md), refusing Nell's offer of a replacement for now. After spending [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) in [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley), [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Hugh return to [Seven Gulls](../codex/places.md#seven-gulls), where Captain Saul shares news from [Adrian Treleaven](../character/adrian-treleaven.md) about his upcoming book publication.
>

> Hugh and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) visit Captain Saul, who agrees that [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) must be informed about Rufus Vane's possible recovery. Hugh then tells [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md), who decides to take Rufus to [Montreal](../codex/places.md#montreal) for surgery despite her shock. Later, [Winifred Tolley](../character/winifred-tolley.md) angrily confronts [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) over the decision, though she ultimately accepts that [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) has made up her mind.
>

> [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) secures funds from Captain Saul and travels to [Montreal](../codex/places.md#montreal) with Hugh and Rufus for the surgery. After returning home, Hugh and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) receive a letter from [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) with a shocking revelation: the man they believed to be Rufus for twelve years is actually his cousin, [Laurence Vane](../character/laurence.md), while the real Rufus died in Cuba long ago.
>

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) gives birth to a healthy baby boy, bringing deep comfort to her and Hugh after their earlier loss. Friends and family gather to admire the newborn, whom they decide to name [James Obed](../character/james-obed.md). Afterward, [Winifred](../character/winifred-tolley.md) tells [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) that [Adrian Treleaven](../character/adrian-treleaven.md) plans to visit [Seven Gulls](../codex/places.md#seven-gulls), bringing up hopes for Lorna's future.
>

> Following the [Liberal](../codex/factions.md#liberal) victory in the election, [Uncle Saul](../character/uncle-saul.md) visits [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) to share the news and discuss politics. Later, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) goes to the Point, where she unknowingly speaks with a newly clean-shaven [Ambrose Kerr](../character/ambrose.md). She then spends time with [Uncle Saul](../character/uncle-saul.md), who contemplates his mortality, asks her to care for his cat Matey when he dies, and listens to her recite a poem by Tennyson.
>

> In the garden, [Adrian Treleaven](../character/adrian-treleaven.md) and [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) declare their love for one another. They join [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), Hugh, and Captain Saul inside by the hearth, where Captain Saul offers a heartfelt blessing over the couples before taking his leave. After Captain Saul and Adrian depart, [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) talk warmly about Lorna's future until [Tabitha](../character/tabitha.md) returns to the house with local gossip.
>

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 38 RED ROSES P9](../source/v04-c38.md#nw-v04-c38-p0009), [v4 CHAPTER 38 RED ROSES P11](../source/v04-c38.md#nw-v04-c38-p0011), [v4 CHAPTER 38 RED ROSES P15](../source/v04-c38.md#nw-v04-c38-p0015), [v4 CHAPTER 38 RED ROSES P35](../source/v04-c38.md#nw-v04-c38-p0035)_

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) deliver [Adrian Treleaven](../character/adrian-treleaven.md) and [James](../character/james-a.md) Garrick's finished book to Captain Saul, who celebrates its arrival with tea and cake. The next morning, Hugh notices that the lighthouse light is still burning past sunrise. Hugh and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) hasten to the lighthouse, where they find Captain Saul has peacefully passed away with his life-book open on his chest.
